description: Source code implementing ASN.1 structure management and memory cleanup functions in OpenSSL's BoringSSL fork, specifically for ASN1 item freeing and cleanup routines.

methods.name: ASN1_item_free
methods.description: Frees an ASN1 structure using ASN1_item_ex_free.

methods.name: ASN1_item_ex_free
methods.description: Recursively frees ASN1 values based on their type, handling primitives, choices, sequences, and external types.

methods.name: ASN1_template_free
methods.description: Frees ASN1 values based on ASN1 templates, handling stack types and individual items.

methods.name: ASN1_primitive_free
methods.description: Frees primitive ASN1 values such as OBJECT, BOOLEAN, NULL, and ANY types.
